WITH w AS (
 SELECT 1 AS id, 'a' AS p, 1 AS k, 2 AS v, CAST(2.5 AS DOUBLE) AS f, DATE '2024-01-29' AS day, 'b' AS txt
 UNION ALL SELECT 2,'a',1,4,CAST(4.5 AS DOUBLE),DATE '2024-01-31','a'
 UNION ALL SELECT 3,'a',3,NULL,CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE),DATE '2024-02-01',CAST(NULL AS TEXT)
 UNION ALL SELECT 4,'a',7,-2,CAST(-2.5 AS DOUBLE),DATE '2024-02-06','c'
 UNION ALL SELECT 5,'a',NULL,8,CAST(8.5 AS DOUBLE),CAST(NULL AS DATE),'d'
 UNION ALL SELECT 6,'b',1,NULL,CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE),DATE '2024-02-27',CAST(NULL AS TEXT)
 UNION ALL SELECT 7,'b',2,NULL,CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE),DATE '2024-02-29','z'
 UNION ALL SELECT 8,'b',2,NULL,CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE),DATE '2024-03-01','x'
 UNION ALL SELECT 9,NULL,2,8,CAST(8 AS DOUBLE),DATE '2024-02-29','y'
 UNION ALL SELECT 10,NULL,NULL,8,CAST(8 AS DOUBLE),DATE '2024-03-06','q'
)
SELECT id,FIRST_VALUE(txt) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY k,id RANGE BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND CURRENT ROW) AS result FROM w ORDER BY id;
